# campaignSlug: # - campaignSlug: references an AdCampaign already defined via import-ad-campaign-asset.js / set-ad-campaign.js
#     image -> slot is the <rect id="..."> the campaign's asset goes into
#     qr    -> slot is the <rect id="..."> for the QR; qrValue encodes as-is if set
#              otherwise falls back to the campaign's targetUrl (trackable promo QR)
#     text  -> slot is the literal {{TOKEN}} in the template replaced with this row's text
# - qrValue: only used when contentType=qr — leave blank to use the campaign's targetUrl instead
# - tariffCode/zoneKey/zoneType: applicability filters — leave blank for wildcard (matches any)
# - priority: higher wins when several placements match the same ticket/slot (default 100)
